verdict.rationale: Independent runtime probes confirm shopify.com serves an agent-oriented llms.txt file, and shopify.dev docs pages (e.g., /docs/agents.md) serve markdown directly at their URL+.md, giving agents machine-readable access to agent-oriented docs (UCP, MCP, AI Toolkit). This is corroborated by first-party docs describing agents.md and ai-toolkit.md as agent-facing resources. Missing for 10: shopify.dev itself returns 404 for /llms.txt (only the main shopify.com domain hosts it), so the agent-doc surface is split across domains rather than unified under one canonical llms.txt.
